name: CreateJobNode
label: Create Job
description: Creates a separate job for another agent, optionally waits for it to finish.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: TargetFlowVersionId
fields.label: Agent
fields.description: The agent version the created job runs.

fields.name: ExecuteOnCloud
fields.label: Execute it on Cloud
fields.description: Runs the created job on the cloud queue instead of a registered machine.

fields.name: Machine
fields.label: Machine
fields.description: Unique name of the registered machine that runs the created job. Required when cloud execution is off.

fields.name: JobInputData
fields.label: Job Input Data
fields.description: Input payload passed to the created job as JSON. Leave empty to send no input data.

fields.name: ExistingJobId
fields.label: Existing Job ID
fields.description: Optional existing job id of the same flow version to reuse with a higher retry count.

fields.name: WaitForCompletion
fields.label: Wait For Completion
fields.description: Waits for the created job and returns its final status and outputs. Fails this step when the job fails or the timeout elapses.

fields.name: PollIntervalSeconds
fields.label: Poll Interval (seconds)
fields.description: How often to check the created job while waiting.

fields.name: TimeoutSeconds
fields.label: Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: How long to wait for the created job before failing this step.

fields.name: Status
fields.label: Status
fields.description: Final status of the created job when waiting is enabled.

fields.name: OutputDataJson
fields.label: Output Data
fields.description: Output data of the created job when waiting is enabled.
